main_text.l: Trajanus, Nifibi & Batnis captis, Parthic. nomen
obtinuit: mox Euphratem, quam folla in
luftrato ibi lacu Afphaltide, & Tigri trajecto,
eft: cum vero eo abfente iterum defciviffent,
misit contra eos Lucium & Maximum, quorum
ifte in praelio occubuit, ille Nifibin & Edeffam
eis dedit; quem tamen illo mortuo
In ÆGYPTO nihil occurrit, praeter Judaeo-
rum circa Cyrenem, duce quodam Andrea,
apud SICAMBROS fi excipias, qui Richimero
Apud HISPANOS vifus eft in Gadiano
etiam Legio civitas a legionibus Germanorum

page.notes: Right margin and lower right are heavily damaged; the text there is partly illegible and was not reliably recovered. Marginal note letters are approximate. Several words at line ends in the left column are uncertain.
